description:
One extension in full: every store listing's latest numbers plus its
tracked keywords and their current positions.

Each listing's rank is its position by users within its store, computed
from the current user count; ties share a rank (rank_tied = others at the
same count); rank_change is the move since last week's recorded rank.

locales lists every store language this extension tracks, with a
keyword count each, so the keywords can be worked a language at a time.

Use get_metrics_history or get_keyword_ranks for movement over time.

This is the tracked view, built from what we have recorded. For an
extension this account does not track, use get_listing instead.

Needs an ExtensionDash account: sign in from your app, e.g. `claude mcp login extensions-dashboard` or `codex mcp login extensions-dashboard`.
name: get_extension
